title: Split storage schema catalog into domain table groups and migration seed boundaries
description: TASK-032 created the persistence boundary, but `schema.rs` is already a broad catalog for conversations, platform state, providers, personas, projects, API keys, cron jobs, and command metadata. Keep schema primitives, table-family builders, migration seeds, and backup manifest consumers separate before concrete SQL backends grow.

files.change: Move schema primitives and AstrBot main DB table groups into a `schema/` module tree while preserving public exports.
Keep migrations consuming declarative schema tables without owning table-family construction.

criteria: Column/table/schema primitives are separate from domain table-family builders.
Conversation, platform, provider, persona/skill, and ops tables can evolve independently.
Migration and backup code consume schema descriptors without depending on route or runtime modules.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
